Jordan / Acme SRE team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, attached is the first draft of the mutual action plan (MAP-Redwood-Acme-20260522.pdf). High-level asks we need to align on this week:

- Test windows: 2x 2-hour runs per region (US west, EU central, APAC) to capture steady-state and peak concurrency. Please confirm availability.
- Metrics we will capture: p50/p95 latency (ms), TTFT (time to first token), sustained throughput (tokens/sec), and max sustainable concurrency before QoS degradation.
- Canary failover simulation: we will run controlled route failures to validate multi-region routing and automatic fallback. Expect ~15–20 minute disruption window for each simulated failure.
- Deliverables: redwood-eval-harness-v2.tar.gz (our runner), acme-regional-test-logs.zip (you provide), and a consolidated perf CSV.

Target timeline in MAP:
- Agreement on test plan: by 2026-05-26
- Execution of regional runs: 2026-05-27 to 2026-05-30
- Canary failover sim: 2026-05-31
- Final results & closure: target sign-off by 2026-06-10

Can you confirm the test windows and who on your side will run the tests (SRE or app team)? If you want, we can run the harness from our dedicated nodes and drop results into the shared Drive link.

Attachments: MAP-Redwood-Acme-20260522.pdf (MAP + testcases), redwood-eval-harness-v2.tar.gz (test harness)

Thanks,

Jordan —

Thanks for the early logs, useful signal. A few technical clarifications from our side before full runs:

1) Harness tweaks: please add the --kv-cache flag in the eval harness so we exercise prefix cache behavior (redwood-eval-harness-v2.tar.gz includes the flag in README). That will affect TTFT under repeated prompt patterns.
2) Concurrency profile: please run these concurrency steps: 1, 8, 16, 32, 64 (where supported). On APAC you noted high variability — if possible please include an isolated run at concurrency=12 to better map the knee.
3) Canary failover: our recommended sim is a route-level blackhole (simulate an AZ/region route failure) followed by an instance drain test for rollback validation. Blackhole test takes ~10 minutes plus a 10-minute steady-state capture; instance drain is lower-impact but validates KV cache rewarm. We'll coordinate a specific minute-by-minute script.

I'll join the runs remotely and stream RT metrics into the shared Grafana dashboard. After the runs we'll compute p50/p95/TTFT and throughput slope (tokens/sec) and attach a summarized CSV (acme-final-perf-summary.csv).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime Engineering, Redwood Inference

Redwood will orchestrate the blackhole from our control plane and coordinate with your SRE for rollback.
- Target sign-off moved up to 2026-06-08 based on availability (procurement aiming to complete SoW countersign) — we will still aim to close commercial terms by 2026-06-10 if needed.

Vanessa / team —

We ran the full harness across the three regions and completed the canary failover sim on 2026-05-31 as planned. Summary (attached: acme-final-perf-summary.csv):

US-west (steady-state @ 32 concurrent): p50=20ms, p95=95ms, TTFT=150ms, throughput=1,800 tokens/sec
EU-central (steady-state @ 24 concurrent): p50=30ms, p95=130ms, TTFT=190ms, throughput=1,350 tokens/sec
APAC (steady-state @ 12 concurrent): p50=55ms, p95=280ms, TTFT=360ms, throughput=620 tokens/sec

Canary failover notes:
- Route blackhole (simulated regional outage): automatic reroute to next-best region completed in 18s median; during re-route we saw elevated p95s for 2m while KV cache warmed. Application-level errors were negligible (<0.02% spike).
- Instance drain rewarm: KV cache rewarm impacted TTFT for ~3 minutes after drain; steady-state recovered within 6 minutes.

Procurement is prepared to review the SoW this week and expects to countersign by 2026-06-08. From our side, results look good and we are comfortable moving to a Dedicated capacity pilot.

Thanks for the smooth coordination. Let us know when you push the DocuSign link and we'll route it to legal/procurement.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior SRE Lead, Acme Corp
